title: Interesting, but single use
text: Interesting, but single use. I was surprised to get a squeegie with this frame until I realized that it is used to get the air out when pressing a photo into the adhesive.  I was thinking it was just a slip in frame that you would change pictures in and out of, but it is a permanant mounting for a single photo.  Once it is stuck to the acrylic, it is there for life.  This is not necessarily horrible, but you may want to know that before you buy it.  And perhaps make sure you aren't putting in a picture you may want to reuse in another way later.  Otherwise the acrylic is perfectly clear, the end product looks great and it is a great frame.
